payload.title: Using Surrogate Series with Pyleoclim
payload.summary: This Jupyter notebook provides an overview of the SurrogateSeries class in the Pyleoclim library, focusing on generating and visualizing surrogate data to assess the significance of various analyses. It covers both parametric and non-parametric surrogate generation methods, including autoregressive models and phase scrambling. The notebook demonstrates how to fit surrogates to specific targets like the NINO3 Index and discusses their use in significance testing. It also explores the generation of unevenly-spaced surrogates and their applications.
goals: Learn how to generate and visualize surrogates with Pyleoclim
Learn how to use surrogates to assess the significance of various analyses
